name: ETA-IL / B/2 Tourist Entry

qualifying_event.description: A traveler from a visa-exempt country registers for ETA-IL (Electronic Travel Authorization) online at least 72 hours before travel; nationals of countries that are not visa-exempt apply for a traditional B/2 visa at an Israeli embassy or consulate instead.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Online ETA-IL registration with passport details, email, and payment; or a B/2 visa application for non-exempt nationalities.

requirements.blocker_text: Approved ETA-IL registration, submitted at least 72 hours before travel, for tourism or business purposes.
requirements.fix_path: Register for ETA-IL online before travel.

requirements.blocker_text: B/2 tourist visa obtained from an Israeli embassy or consulate before travel.

outcome.duration_length: ETA-IL authorization valid up to 2 years (or until passport expiry); each visit capped at 90 days

sources.title: National Law Review (legal news) -- Israel's ETA-IL program: registration required at least 72 hours before travel, ILS 25 (~USD 7) fee, authorization valid up to 2 years, 90-day maximum stay per visit; denied applicants directed to apply for a traditional visa
